data.name: The Bloody Fist
data.agenda: Secure profitable contracts and expand influence across the Acasian marches
keyNPCs: Captain Rusk — Former Ykrul hostage, pragmatic commander
The Black Colonel — Legendary commander, possibly dead
The Veteran Sergeant — Counts scars like coin
The Banner-Captain — Griffon standard bearer
data.resources: Soldiers, siege equipment, camp followers, war horses
hooks: The Black Colonel's death is being covered up
data.description: The Bloody Fist are the largest and most feared mercenary company in Acasia. Their standards are black, their contracts are iron, and their loyalty ends at the next payday. They have served every kingdom and betrayed every kingdom—but they always collect their coin.
data.territory: Acasia, Vhasia, and the northern marches

data.name: Ecktorian Censorate
data.agenda: Root out heresy, illegal magic, and political dissent across the province
keyNPCs: Censor Cassia — Aging magistrate with a silver eye
Prefect Gaius Marcellus — Commander of the garrison
The Grand Magistrate — Guardian of forms
High Priest of the Everflame — Smiles like law
data.resources: Legal authority, archive access, witch-hunters, military escorts
hooks: They are investigating the party's activities
Censor Cassia is dying—she wants to destroy the Iron Seal before she goes
Prefect Marcellus has a secret cult of oath-breakers
data.description: The Ecktorian Censorate is the law enforcement and intelligence arm of the Utaran Imperium's successor states. They root out heresy, illegal magic, and political dissent with bureaucratic precision. Their clerks outnumber their soldiers, and their archives hold the secrets of a hundred fallen nobles.
data.territory: Ecktoria, Castra Ferrum, and the Acasian border

data.name: Gray Ash Ykrul
data.agenda: Secure winter grazing lands and protect the clan from Ecktorian encroachment
keyNPCs: Khatun Sarnai — Proud chieftain of the Gray Ash
Yelü — Sarnai's daughter, child of a legionary
The Sky-Speaker — Shaman of storms
The Kon'reh Master — Geometry arbiter
data.resources: Steppe riders, remounts, steppe knowledge, hostage strings
hooks: A hostage string has been cut—blood-price is due
data.description: The Gray Ash are a Ykrul clan of the Violet Steppe, known for their wolf-standards and fierce independence. They measure distance in oaths and remounts, not miles. Every child learns: count your exits before you enter, never commit to a single path, and an ally untested is a blade without a sheath.

data.name: House Contarini (Vilikari)
data.agenda: Expand trade routes into Acasia and monopolize the grain trade
keyNPCs: Tema — Vilikari merchant and grain factor
Factor Voss — Mid-level bureaucrat under audit
The Archivolot — Notary who seals fates with wax
The Federate King — Paramount ruler of the Vilikari
data.resources: Trade network, legal influence, grain, shipping, forged charters
hooks: A rival house is undercutting their prices
The Valvano Ford is locked—grain cannot move
Tema has invested everything in this trade route
data.description: House Contarini is one of the great Vilikari trading houses, controlling grain shipments, legal charters, and diplomatic connections across the Amaranthine. They are not a noble house in the traditional sense—they are a family of merchants whose wealth exceeds that of most kings.

data.name: The Iron League
data.agenda: Consolidate mercenary contracts and dominate the condotta market
keyNPCs: The Black Colonel — Legendary commander, not seen in months
Captain Rusk — Pragmatic mercenary captain
The Veteran Sergeant — Counts scars like coins
Clan-Mother — Ykrul war-braid keeper
data.resources: Mercenary companies, military intelligence, siege equipment, camp followers
hooks: Payday is late — morale is dropping
A condotta is threatening to flip sides mid-contract
The Black Colonel may be dead, but his banner still rides
data.description: The Iron League is a coalition of free companies, condottieri, and mercenary captains who sell steel to whoever can pay. They have no loyalty to any nation—only to the next payday. Their camps are ragged, their discipline iron, and their grudges longer than any contract.
data.territory: Acasia, Vhasia, and the Violet Steppe

data.name: The Velvet Court
data.agenda: Control Silkstrand's underworld and expand influence to the Brass Coast
keyNPCs: Madam Serafine — Mistress of the Velvet Court
Old Kes — Fence and smuggler
Sister Agatha — Sanctuary keeper
The Archivist — Legal forger
The Gray Eminence — Unknown power behind the scenes
data.resources: Information network, forgery, laundering, blackmail files, safehouses
hooks: A rival faction is moving into the Dye District
Madam Serafine is still paying off a debt to Livaea
The Gray Eminence's true identity remains a mystery
data.description: The Velvet Court is not a building. It is a network—of whispers, of debts, of favors owed and collected. It has no single leader, though many claim the title. It has no charter, no treasury, no walls. It is the space between the legitimate and the condemned, and its members are the ones who know how to walk that line.
